notes.title: DEVLOG #5 - Playtest Started
notes.content:
[p][b]Just as the title states, after many months of hard work, we can finally invite you to be among first players to experience the dangerous and treacherous Deadlands. [/b][/p][p][/p][p]We are extremely excited for this opportunity, we hope you will be enjoying this title as much as we are enjoying making it for you. [/p][p][/p][p]For now it is only a sneak peak of first couple missions, the game is still in Alpha phase, so there are a lot of things to be polished and tweaked, but that is why your help at this stage of development is so important to us. After finishing Playtest you will have a chance to [b]fill out the survey[/b], in which we ask many important questions towards further development and improvements of our game.[/p][p][/p][p][b]We will at first invite only a smaller group of players and will be gradually inviting more players in the next days.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Also, if you have not yet signed-up for a Playtest, don't worry, you can still do so, from our Steam Page for a chance to be selected.[/p][p][/p][p]That is all from us for now, it's with great pleasure we are giving you a chance to try our game and give us your feedback. Keep your engines roaring and your cargo secured. 

Dust & Diesel Team.[/p]

notes.title: Devlog #4 - Playtest Sign-Ups Are Now Open!
notes.content:
[p][b]Dear Truckers, the wasteland is calling!
[/b]
We’re excited to announce that we’re gearing up for the first [b]Playtest[/b] of Dust & Diesel: Deadland Delivery! Soon, you’ll have the chance to get behind the wheel, explore the open world in a first couple of missions, and put your skills to the test in the harsh post-apocalyptic terrain.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45130832/a0c611925b9c7a00fedd87b60341f70fcd2129ab.png"][/img][/p][p]We’re inviting you all to sign up for access to the playtest. This will be a limited test, and those who join will have the opportunity to provide feedback that will help shape the game. [/p][p]The exact date of the [b]Playtest[/b] will be revealed later, but for now, you can [b]Sign Up[/b] to secure your spot. Stay tuned for more updates, and get ready to hit the road! Until next time, drive safe, stay armored.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]Those who have not heard yet we have expanded our development to other game linked below. notes.title: DEVLOG #3 – Time To Get Armored
notes.content: [p][b]Hey everyone,[/b][/p][p]First off, we want to sincerely apologize for the delay in posting this devlog. We know many of you have been eagerly waiting for updates, and we truly appreciate your patience. The good news is development is moving forward according to plan, and today’s devlog is one we’ve been especially excited to share. We hope it’ll make the wait worth it.[/p][p][b]Let’s talk armor.[/b][/p][p]Take a look at this comparison.[/p][p][/p][p]First, you can see the vehicle every player starts with: worn out, rusted, and completely unprotected. It’s a workhorse, but one that’s seen better days.[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45130832/34c5a5031eb12a4f02224d398f0572a3775c8646.png"][/img][/p][p]Next up? That same truck, with some light-weight armor put on it, for some basic protection while maintaining the high speed and flexibility. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45130832/c906eec8dc0b6d4e47b3ac4ae889fcc8416023f7.png"][/img][/p][p]Finally truck, fully armored up and battle-ready, a beast built to survive the wasteland.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45130832/6ae348f2ff5dba649c37e2eb43a56206b3c303c8.png"][/img][/p][p]In [i]Dust & Diesel[/i], armor isn’t just cosmetic. It’s a [b]modular system[/b] you’ll upgrade and install piece by piece in your garage. Whether it's reinforced doors, engine plating, roof shielding, or window bars, every panel you bolt on adds crucial protection.[/p][p][b]But armor comes with trade-offs.[/b][/p][p]The more you install, the more durable your truck becomes, but also heavier and slower. Go light and agile, or build a near-indestructible road tank. The choice is yours.[/p][p]Enemies won’t just chip away at your health bar, they’ll tear into your armor plate by plate. You’ll need to repair, replace, and rethink your build as you take on tougher deliveries and more dangerous regions.[/p][p]We’ve designed this system to give you deep customization while keeping every upgrade meaningful and impactful.[/p][p]We can’t thank you enough for the support you’ve shown us so far. Every message, wishlist, and comment pushes us to keep going. The whole team is working hard to deliver something truly unique, and we’re just getting started.[/p][p]If you haven’t yet, be sure to [b]join our Discord[/b] to chat with the devs and other players, and don’t forget to [b]wishlist [i]Dust & Diesel: Deadland Delivery[/i] on Steam[/b] so you never miss an update.[/p][p]More exciting reveals are just around the corner. Until next time, drive safe, stay armored.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]Those who have not heard yet we have expanded our development to other game linked below. Feel free to check it out and feel free to wishlist and follow to get new information faster! :)  [/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2614370/Mr_Nomad/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Follow us on social media:[/p][p][/p][p]TikTok: [/p][p][url="https://www.tiktok.com/@rejectedgames"]https://www.tiktok.com/@rejectedgames[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Discord: [/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/FS5U3mUWQ8"]https://discord.gg/FS5U3mUWQ8[/url][/p][p][/p][p]X (ex-Twitter): [/p][p][url="https://x.com/rejected_games"]https://x.com/rejected_games[/url][/p][p][/p][p]– The [i]Dust & Diesel[/i] Team[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Devlog #2 – Junkyard
notes.content:
[b]Hello Dear Truckers,[/b] 

[b]Big News Coming Soon[/b]

We know it has been quite some time since our last Devlog, but don’t worry our team is hard at work, preparing some big announcement for you very soon, but in the meantime, we didn’t want to leave you with nothing new.

[b]So today we present you the Junkyard[/b]. A special place where you will go to in order to collect all sorts of metal components needed for your deliveries. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45130832/8c6627cd71fed8e2438775572abb7a3719f2ad82.png[/img]

[b]We also want to give you some more sneak peak into our world[/b], you will be travelling vast canyons, filled with tricky terrain and dangerous bandits roaming around and it is just one of many different biomes we are working on, you can expect treacherous deserts, snowy rocky mountains and foggy, mysterious swamps to name a few.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45130832/a0c611925b9c7a00fedd87b60341f70fcd2129ab.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45130832/1a738abd271a72a582a64ef8f5f790815b5ba290.png[/img]

To end todays Devlog we are leaving you with a sneak-peak of a cockpit view from our Truck. We will have more detailed screenshots and information in our next Devlogs, but until then [b]keep your engines roaring and your cargo secure!
[/b]

notes.title: Devlog #1 - Welcome to Deadlands
notes.content:
[b]Hello Dear Truckers[/b],

First off all, a massive THANK YOU to everyone who has shown interest in Dust & Diesel: Deadland Delivery on Steam and joined our growing community on Discord. Your support, feedback, and excitement mean the world to us and fuel our drive to make this game something truly special. Today after much time spend on further developing our game we can finally share some really exciting news with you.

[b]Monthly Devlogs Incoming[/b]

We’re excited to announce that starting today, we’ll be posting monthly devlogs! These updates will give you a behind-the-scenes look at our development journey. Expect sneak peeks of gameplay mechanics, map designs, and much more. Each devlog will give you a better idea of what to expect in the wastelands of Dust & Diesel.

[b]A Small Sneak Peak of Our Game[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45130832/a5fddcf6a784519d4f90e3de1cbb4337a4c910ba.png[/img]

Our team was hard at work moving our game to Unreal Engine 5 to make sure our game uses the newest cutting-edge tech. This month, we’re showcasing one of our trucks, set against a stunning in-game terrain. Here’s your first real taste of the visual possibilities we’re crafting using the power of Unreal Engine 5. With its advanced lighting, massive world-building capabilities, and cutting-edge tools, Unreal Engine 5 allows us to push the boundaries of post-apocalyptic immersion. The gritty details of the truck, combined with the harsh beauty of the terrain, aim to capture the heart of Dust & Diesel’s survival-driven gameplay.

[b]Stay Tuned[/b]

There’s much more to come, and we’re eager to share the journey with you. Don’t forget to wishlist Dust & Diesel on Steam if you haven’t already and join us on Discord to connect with fellow drivers, share your thoughts, and stay up-to-date with all things Dust & Diesel.

Until next time, keep your engines roaring and your cargo secure!

~ Rejected Games
